The petitioner filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act 1989, seeking compensation of Rs.50,00,000/ for the injures sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 26.04.2022.

sentences.text:
It is the case of the petitioner that, on 26.04.2022 at about 13.00 hours, he was crossing the road near Ramamurthy Nagar ring road,, infront of HDFC Bank, Bengalru, at that time the driver of Baleno Maruthi Car bearing registration M.V.C.No.3891/2022 4 SCCH - 7 No.KA03NL9478 drove the same at high speed and in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the petitioner,
due to impact he fell down and sustained grievous injuries to all over the body.
Immediately he was shifted to Hosmat Hospital, Bengaluru, wherein he took treatment as an inpatient.

Prior to the accident he was hale and healthy and aged about 48 years and he was working as a welder at M/s.Core Geotech India Pvt. Ltd., and earning Rs.32,000/ p.m. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident he became permanently disabled.

This accident is took place due to the negligence of the driver of the Baleno Maruthi Car bearing registration No.KA03NL 9478 as such the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to him.
Hence, he prayed to allow the petition.
3. In response to the notice, the respondent No.1 to 3 are appeared through their counsel and respondent No.1 and 3 M.V.C.No.3891/2022 5 SCCH - 7 filed their written statement.
The respondent No.2 has not filed written statement.
4. In the written statement the respondent No.1 denied the entire contention of the petitioner.
Further contended that there is no negligence on the part of the driver of the Car and there was a total negligence on the part of the petitioner.

Further he contended that the Car bearing No.KA03 NL9478 insured with the 3rd respondent and respondent No.2 being the driver of the said vehicle possess a valid and effective driving licence at the time of accident, hence he is not liable to pay any compensation to the petitioner, hence he prayed to dismiss the petition.
5.
The respondent No.3  insurer denied the entire contentions of the petitioner.
Further the respondent No.2 contended that the Car bearing No.KA03NL9478 was not insured by them as on the date of accident.

Further at the time of M.V.C.No.3891/2022 6 SCCH - 7 accident there was no permit and fitness certificate Car bearing No.KA03NL9478 and owner by allowing such a vehicle to ply on the road has violated the terms and conditions of the policy.
Further the driver of the Car has no driving licence to drive the Car as on the date of accident as such they are not liable to pay any compensation to the petitioner.
Hence, on all these grounds, the respondent No.3 has prayed for dismissal of claim petition.
6. On the basis of above pleadings following Issues were framed.

:: I S S U E S ::
(1) Whether petitioner proves that the accident occurred due to rash and negligent act of driving of Gbaleno (Maruti) Car bearing registration No.KA M.V.C.No.3891/2022 7 SCCH - 7 03NL9478 and as a result, he sustained injuries?
(2) Whether the Petitioner proves the age and earnings of the Petitioner as stated in the claim petition?

The respondent No.1 got examined himself as RW1 and got marked Ex.R1 to Ex.R3 and closed their side.
Heard the arguments of both side.

9. My findings to the above referred Issues are as under;
 Issue No.1 : In the affirmative  Issue No.2 : Partly in the affirmative  Issue No.3 : Partly in the affirmative  Issue No.4 :

for the following.......

Issue No.1: The petitioner examined himself as PW.1 and in his examination in chief he deposed as per the contentions taken by him and got marked FIR as per Ex.P 1, Complaint as per Ex.P2, Spot mahazar as per Ex.P3, Spot sketch as per Ex.P4, IMV report as per Ex.P5, wound certificate as per Ex.P6 and Charge Sheet as per Ex.P.7.

By perusing these documents it is clearly goes to show that this accident was took place due to the negligence on the part of driver Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration M.V.C.No.3891/2022 9 SCCH - 7 No.KA03NL9478.
Further in the crossexamination of PW1, by respondent No.1, he deposed that this accident was took place on 26.04.2022 on Ramamurthynagar.
He was working in Metro, at the time of accident it was lunch time and he was going for lunch this accident was took place.
His wife lodge complaint about this accident, but he do not know when complaint is lodged.
He denied that he was crossing the road by talking in the mobile and due to his negligence this accident was took place.
Further he denied that colluding with the police they have lodged false complaint against the driver of Car bearing No.KA 03NL 9478.
He denied that there is no negligence on the part of the driver of the Car.

11. In the crossexamination by respondent No.3, he deposed that this accident was took place on Kasthuraba Nagar to K.R.Puram road and at the center of the road metro work is going on and he denied that where the accident was took M.V.C.No.3891/2022 10 SCCH - 7 place there are barricade.
Further he deposed that where this accident was took place there is no Zebra crossing.

sentences.text: Further he deposed that in order to cross the road, he get down from the footpath to the main road.
Further he admitted when this accident was took place there was heavy traffic movement at the spot of the accident.
He denied that this accident was took place only due to the his negligence and there is no negligence on the part of the driver of Car bearing No.Ka03NL9478.
He denied that as per the spot sketch this accident was took place on the center of the road.
12. From the cross examination of PW1 by respondent No.1 and 3 it is clear that while petitioner was proceeding for lunch by crossing the road at that time this accident was took place.
Further in the cross examination of PW1 by respondent No.1 and 3 nothing contrary is brought on record to disbelieve the case of the petitioner.

Further by M.V.C.No.3891/2022 11 SCCH - 7 perusing the charge sheet marked as per Ex.P7, it is clear that the investigation officer after conducting investigation came to conclusion that this accident was took place due to negligence of the driver of Car bearing No. KA03NL9478.
Further by perusing the wound certificate marked as per Ex.P6 it goes to show that in this accident the petitioner has sustained grievous injuries.

Further to rebut the case of the petitioner the respondent No.1 is examined himself as RW1 and in his examination chief he deposed as per contentions taken by him and he got marked RC of Car bearing No.KA03 NL9478 as per Ex.R1, policy copy as per Ex.R2, Aadhaar Card of respondent No.1 as per Ex.R3.
This witness is not cross examined by the petitioner.
The respondent No.3 has not adduced any oral or documentary evidence.

Hence, by perusing oral and documentary evidence adduced by petitioner, I am of the considered view that this accident was took place due to negligence of the M.V.C.No.3891/2022 12 SCCH - 7 driver of the Car bearing No.KA03NL94778 and in this accident the petitioner has sustained severe injuries.
Hence, I answered the Issue No.1 in the affirmative.

Due to the injuries sustained in the accident he became permanently disabled.
14. In order to prove the age of the petitioner, he relied on the wound certificate marked as per Ex.P6, wherein the age of the petitioner is shown as 48 years.
Hence, the age of petitioner is considered at 48 years as on the date of accident.

15. So for as income of the petitioner is concern the petitioner contended that he was working as Welder at M/s. Coregeo Tech (India) Pvt. Ltd., and thereby earning Rs.32,000/ p.m.
M.V.C.No.3891/2022 13 SCCH - 7
In support of this contention the petitioner has got examined Assistant Manager, HR & Liaisoning officer of M/s. Coregeo Tech (India) Pvt. Ltd., as PW3.
He deposed that their company is paid Rs.2,90,000/ towards hospital bill for the treatment taken by the petitioner due to the injures sustained in this accident.
The petitioner was not covered either ESI or any medical schemes, as the petitioner is worked for few days before he met with an accident.
As the he worked for 26 days there after met with an accident on 26.04.2023 and for 26 days they have paid salary to the petitioner.
He has produced authorization letter marked as per Ex.P18, salary slip as per Ex.P19 and bank statement as per Ex.P20 and 21.

In his crossexamination he deposed that he was working as Admin at Coregeo Tech India Pvt. Ltd., and in the month of October 2022 he left the job from Coregeo Tech India Pvt. sentences.text: He further deposed that he was knowing that their company was agreed to pay Rs.30,000/ per month salary to the petitioner, but he do not know what was the salary of the petitioner.
Further he deposed that in order to show that their company has paid Rs.2,90,000/ hospital bill he has produced the documents.
Further he deposed that the Ex.P20 and 21 are not pertaining to petitioner.
Further he deposed that still the petitioner is not appeared for his job and in feature it is difficult for the petitioner to continue the job due to the injuries sustained in the accident.
He denied that in their company is not paying salary to the petitioner.

Further deposed that at the time of accident the petitioner was not having any amount for his treatment, as per request of the petitioner's wife on the condition to return amount they have paid hospital bill of Rs.2,90,000/.
He denied that only M.V.C.No.3891/2022 15 SCCH - 7 to help the petitioner he has got created document and deposing falsely.

16. From the evidence of PW3 it is clear that the petitioner was working under Coregeo Tech India Pvt. Ltd., in the said company is contractor for Bengaluru Metro Train Project and the petitioner was working in Bengaluru Metro Train Project.

The PW3 has produced the salary slip as per Ex.P19 wherein by perusing the same it goes to show that net salary of the petitioner of Rs.28,000/
and from the evidence of PW3 it goes to show that the PW3 is not knowing what was gross salary of the petitioner.

Further the petitioner has produced the joining letter and pay slip as per Ex.P12 and P10, by perusing the salary slip as per Ex.P10 it goes to show that the gross salary of the petitioner was Rs.32,000/ and deduction of Rs.2,000/ and net salary of Rs. 30,000/.
Further by perusing the joining report marked as per Ex.P12, wherein by perusing the M.V.C.No.3891/2022 16 SCCH - 7 same it goes to show that the salary was fixed at Rs.30,000/ per month.
These documents goes to show that the petitioner salary was fixed at Rs.30,000/ p.m., and as per Ex.P12 it is clear that on 01.04.2022 he has join the job and on 26.04.2022 he met with an accident.
The petitioner has produced the salary slips as per Ex.P10, 12 and 19 nothing contrary is brought on record to disprove the case of the petitioner.
By perusing Ex.P19 it goes to show that for 26 days the petitioner was given salary of Rs.28,000/.
Hence monthly income of the petitioner is considered at Rs.30,000/ and the occupation of the petitioner is considered as welding work.
Hence, I answered the Issue No.2 partly in the affirmative.
17. Issue No.3:
The petitioner contended that in the accident he has sustained injuries to his back bones and head.
Due to the injuries he is not in a position to do any work and he M.V.C.No.3891/2022 17 SCCH - 7 is permanently disabled.
In support of this contention the petitioner got examined Dr.Nagaraj B.N. Orthopedics Surgeon as PW.2.
The PW.2 deposed that petitioner has met with in the RTA on 26.04.2022 and sustained D12 vertebra fracture with Paraperasis and Scute Subdural hemorrhage.
Petitioner took treatment at Hosmat Hospital and under went surgery for the injuries sustained to vertibra fracture.
Now the petitioner is having pain in back, unable to lift weights, weakness of both lower limbs.
On his examination he found healed scar over the back, wasting of the lower limb muscles.
As per recent Xray of the DL spine shows consolidated fracture of D12 vertebra with implant in situ and the petitioner is having disability of 30%.
He has produced clinical notes as per Ex.P16 and Xray as per Ex.P17.

In the cross examination he deposed that he has not treated to the petitioner and he verified only wound certificate and discharge summary of the M.V.C.No.3891/2022 18 SCCH - 7 petitioner and not taken any suggestion from the treated doctor.

He denied that the D12 vertibra is related to nerves injury Yogesh M.L vs Saikat Roy Choudhury on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153324296/
6 and also denied that as the petitioner sustained nerve injuries and as such he is competent person to assess the disability of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Further he deposed that the injuries caused to D12 vertibra is healed and apart from that injuries the petitioner is sustained head injury and he has not assessed any disability to the head injury.
He denied that only in order to help the petitioner he has assessed disability of higher side.
Further he deposed that he do not have any personal knowledge about work of the petitioner.
The petitioner can do sitting job.
Further he denied that only to help of the petitioner he has assessed disability of higher side and deposing falsely.
18. From the evidence of PW2 it is clear that in this accident the petitioner has sustained fracture of D12 vertibra and head injury.
Now the injuries are healed.
The PW2 is M.V.C.No.3891/2022 19 SCCH - 7 assessed disability for fracture of D12 vertibra.
The PW.2 has stated that the petitioner has total disability of 30%, the doctor has not stated functional disability.

As the petitioner is working as welder and while doing welding work the petitioner has stand and sit for long time, he has to lift the weight, but due to the injuries sustained to D12 vertibra the petitioner is not in a position to lift weight and sit and stand for long time while doing welding work.
The injuries caused to the petitioner definitely causing some inconvenience for the petitioner to do his welding job.

Hence, by considering age occupation and nature of injuries and also relying on the authority reported in (2011) 1 SCC 343 between Rajkumar V/s. Ajay Kumar the functional disability of the petitioner is considered as 8% to the whole body.
With regard to the quantum, the age of the petitioner is considered as 48 years and the income is considered at Rs.30,000/ p.m.
As per Sarala Varma's Case the multiplier 13 is applicable and functional disability is considered at 8%.

On considering the avocation and age of the petitioner, the total loss of future income is calculated as (Rs.30,000/ X 12 X 13 X 8/100) = Rs.3,74,400/.
Hence, an amount of Rs.3,74,400/ is awarded to the petitioner under the head loss of future income for the permanent disability suffered by him in the accident.
20.
In this accident the petitioner has sustained D12 vertebra fracture with Paraperasis and Acute Subdural Hemorrhage and undergone surgery.

It shows that definitely the petitioner has suffered some pain due to the injuries sustained in the accident, hence an amount of Rs.50,000/ is awarded towards pain and sufferings.
M.V.C.No.3891/2022 21 SCCH - 7 21.

Further due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner might have taken rest for at least for a period of two months and during this period he might have taken nutritious food and taken assistance of an attendant hence an amount of Rs.60,000/ is awarded under the head of loss of earning during the period of treatment, rest, nourishment and attendant charges.
Further the petitioner has produced hospital and Medical Bills as per Ex.P.9 for Rs.3,05,000/ and Ex.P.11 for Rs.9,446/ in total amount of Rs.3,14,446/.
Hence the petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.3,14,446/ under the head of hospital and medical expenses.

23.
While answering the issue No.1 this Tribunal comes to the conclusion that, accident occurred due to the negligence of the driver of Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration No.KA03NL9478.

The petitioner contended that the respondent No.1 is the owner, the respondent No.2 is the driver and respondent No.3 is the insurer of the said vehicle they are jointly ans severally liable to pay compensation to him.
The respondent No.3 has admitted that as on the date of the accident the policy issued to the said Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration No.KA03NL M.V.C.No.3891/2022 23 SCCH - 7 9478 was in force.
Nothing worth is brought on record to show that there is violation of terms and conditions of the policy by the owner of the Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration No.KA03NL9478.

Hence the respondent No.1 being the owner, respondent No.2 is the driver and the respondent No.3 being the insurer of the Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration No.KA03NL9478 are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner with interest at the rate of 6% p.a from the date of petition.
Hence, I answered the issue No.3 in partly affirmative.
24. Issue No.4:

For the above stated reasons I proceed to pass the following;
:ORDER:
Claim petition filed by the petitioner U/Sec 166 of M.V. Act is partly allowed with costs of Rs.1,000/.
 M.V.C.No.3891/2022  24 SCCH - 7  Petitioner is awarded just and reasonable compensation of Rs.8,23,846/ (Rupees Eight Lakh Twenty Three Thousand Eight Hundred and Forty Six Only) with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition to till the date of depositing of the compensation amount in the court.
The respondent No.3 being insurer of Baleno Maruti Car bearing registration No.KA03NL9478 is directed to deposit the awarded compensation amount in the Court within 02 month from the date of this judgment.
